data.current_summary: Recalibrate an Audience's grounding and members
data.current_description: Refreshes the stored grounding of a saved Audience and re-allocates its members to the resulting distributions. Owner only. `deepen` (Go deeper) runs in the background and returns 202 at once with `data.research` (`jobId`, `phase: researching`) and `data.progressUrl`: it researches what the Audience still lacks (every standard dimension its coverage reports missing or assumed, plus `deepen.topics`) with the whole evidence pool and the coverage check, adds it to the saved grounding (every chart the Audience has stays; a chart gives way only to stronger evidence for the same question, or for the dimension it stands for), and recalibrates the members through the same step as any recalibration, between Study runs and validations, never under one (members keep answering with their previous version until their retrain lands). Follow it on `GET /audiences/{audienceId}/progress`: `research.phase` is `researching` until `researched`, `research.stage` moves researching → waiting_for_runs → recalibrating → done, and `research.outcome` reports the charts and sources added, the dimensions improved, the members recalibrated and, per requested topic, whether a chart was `added` (with its evidence tier), `already_covered` or `not_found`. It is refused with 409 `AUDIENCE_RESEARCH_RUNNING` while the Audience's background research runs; `sources` and `instruction` sent with it join the Audience's source bundle first. Two modes otherwise: research mode (default) re-runs deep research from the persisted brief, every earlier adjustment and the optional `instruction`, `sources` and `requestedDistribution`, or from `query` as a full override; selection mode (`distributions` present) skips research and only replaces the active distribution set, keeping the stored sources and review universe. In research mode the instruction is classified first: an adjustment ("make men 40%", "now they are all vegan", "only 50 to 60 years old") re-allocates the existing roster and rebuilds or evolves the members whose new segment contradicts who they are, while an additive instruction ("and now add 10 African consumers") keeps the existing members untouched and creates new ones within the plan's member cap. Without `deepen`, acceptance returns 202 immediately with `data.operation`; research and roster changes run on the processor. Poll its `statusUrl` or `GET /audiences/{audienceId}` (`calibration.operation`) for the retained result or terminal error. Send a stable `requestKey` or `Idempotency-Key` on retries: the same key and input replay the same operation, even after completion; changed input with that key returns 409. Member training continues after the roster change. Poll `GET /audiences/{audienceId}/progress` for per-member training and `GET /audiences/{audienceId}` for `calibration.active`. Only one recalibration may run per Audience at a time. Because recalibration rewrites the members' profiles and knowledge globally, it is refused with 409 `AUDIENCE_MINDS_SHARED` when members also belong to other Audiences unless `allowSharedMinds: true` is sent (additive runs are exempt). It is also refused with 409 `STUDY_RUN_USES_MINDS` while a Study run is answering with these members, since rewriting them mid-run changes who answers it (additive runs are exempt); retry when the run has finished or cancel it.
